methods.name: Low-level fish (sardine to salmon)
methods.note: Sardine, herring, mackerel, trout, pike then salmon on a range. Cook's Assistant, Gertrude's Cat and two RFD subquests skip to 18.

methods.name: Bake Pie spell
methods.note: Cast on bought uncooked pies, 3 ticks each and they never burn. About 113k Magic xp an hour on top. Pie supply is thin.

methods.name: Sweetcorn at Kastori
methods.note: Pick raw sweetcorn in the Kastori fields and cook it on the ovens beside them. No supplies needed. Up to 70k an hour at 54.

methods.name: Karambwan (1-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect cooking at a fire next to a bank such as Rogues' Den, about 5,000 an hour. Fastest Cooking xp there is.

methods.name: Karambwan (normal speed)
methods.note: Hosidius kitchen until 96, then a fire next to a bank. Ironmen fish them at 65 Fishing or buy from Tiadeche's stall.

methods.name: Fish (tuna to anglerfish)
methods.note: Tuna, lobster, swordfish or monkfish, shark, then anglerfish. Rates assume cooking gauntlets and the Hosidius kitchen range.

methods.name: Cakes from an oak larder
methods.note: Take cake ingredients from your own oak larder and bake on a range by the house portal. Unlimited supplies, very click intensive.

methods.name: Servery pineapple pizzas (Mess hall)
methods.note: Make pizzas from the free ingredients in the Hosidius Mess and hop worlds after each load. No supplies, very click intensive.

methods.name: Jugs of wine
methods.note: Grapes into jugs of water, 14 an inventory, never fails from 68. Ironmen get grapes from Zulrah, Vorkath or the Culinaromancer's Chest.

unverified: Low-level fish (sardine to salmon): neither guide gives an hourly rate for levels 1 to 30, so xph is 0
Sweetcorn at Kastori: the only figure is 'up to 70,000 at level 54'; 59,500 is 85% of that, not a level 28 rate

Fish (tuna to anglerfish): each band is the midpoint of the guide's range for that fish; rates assume cooking gauntlets (Family Crest) and the Hosidius kitchen (Kourend & Kebos easy diary, elite from 79), left out of req because they are not hard requirements
Karambwan (normal speed): rate assumes the Hosidius kitchen; ironmen need 65 Fishing to finish Tai Bwo Wannai Trio and the Ironman Guide gives no rate of its own
Jugs of wine and both karambwan entries: cost is a judgement call because the guide's profit figures are live GE price templates
Servery pineapple pizzas and Sweetcorn at Kastori: no access requirement is stated in the cached text

Omitted for lack of a Cooking level in the text: Frankie's Fishing Emporium bass and swordfish (~100,000/h), Flosi's fish shop, sacred eels (~20,000/h), Tempoross passive xp, poison karambwan 1-ticking for 1 to 30 (no rate)
